Delivered:

- src/app/widgetCatalog.ts and src/features/overview/layout.ts define a closed seven-widget presentation catalog: waiting, tasks, deliverables, working together, department requests/reviews, calendar and resources. Only wide/compact size and stable IDs/order are accepted; no route, query, permission, SQL, HTML, data payload or FIN/disabled PRISM/mentoring widget input. Unknown/retired/duplicate IDs, unknown fields, invalid sizes, non-plain objects and guest-ineligible destinations reject to useful defaults. Next actions/help are outside this schema and cannot be removed.
- Overview retains the existing independently authorized read_overview RPC. Task/waiting/work summaries use only its returned rows and counts, not arbitrary source queries. Calendar/resources cards open existing independently authorized workspaces; they do not pretend to show queried calendar dates or guide content. No new backend query or permission is granted. Existing row titles/UUID links, TASK/DEL references, owner/committee/person/state, requested versus accepted dates, due dates and overdue distinctions remain in shared OverviewViews.tsx.
- LayoutControls.tsx adds optional secondary-view selection, responsive wide/compact placement and real Move up/down buttons. Moving preserves focus on an enabled control and announces position. Edits save presentation IDs/sizes automatically on this device, scoped by organization/term/member membership or guest access. No work titles, work-record IDs, counts or work payloads are stored; preference keys include the organization/term/subject identifiers. Default works without setup; required task/help/contact route is always visible even during loading/error. Storage failure explains that the current view is temporary; invalid/retired/unreadable config shows a visible fallback notice and explicit Restore default view repair. This is a personal device preference, not a published role layout, account-synced setting or named multi-view system.
- LayoutPreview.tsx lazily mounts four clearly fictional late-joiner/no-work, assignee, head/missing-reviewer and guest/shared-task examples using the same lane/help/secondary components. The preview uses no impersonation, no selected real account, no extra API query and no work mutation. Example record links are disabled/illustrative; ordinary help/workspace links open the viewer's own permitted destinations. Guest-ineligible selected widgets fall back to the guest-safe default. Existing actual guest routing remains /shared; a fictional layout is not provider guest-authorization evidence.
- overview.css reuses calm/Karla/accent tokens with one column on narrow screens and optional two-column compact cards at900px. Work/help/arrangement controls meet the observed44px target. General branding/navigation and existing published definitions remain unchanged. No schema, migrations, generated types or provider settings changed.
